concept.title: e_ride
concept.shortdesc: e-Ride controls the vehicle’s sensors and drive motor torque to help soften the impact when passing over obstacles such as speed bumps, and detects and adjusts the vehicle’s movement to provide a more comfortable and stable driving performance.

conbody.p: e-Ride does not operate in the following circumstances.

li.p: When your vehicle is in manual shift mode or SPORT mode
When ABS and ESC is activated
When vehicle speed is 55 km/h (35 mph) or faster
When your vehicle is driving off-road, making sharp turns, or shifting gears

conbody.p: Once these conditions are cleared, e-Ride will operate when driving over speed bumps.

note.p: e-Ride stands for Electrically-controlled Ride Comfort
